title: Sanctifying Spirit promised only to believers and penitents
source_text: XVIII. Spiritus enim ille sanctificans, & animam gratia replens atque exornans, non promittitur in Evangelio nisi credentibus & poenitentibus. Qui credit in me, inquit Christus, flumina de ventre ejus fluent aquae vivae. Hoc autem dicit de Spiritu quem ac-cepturi erant credentes in eum. Joan. 7. 38. Petrus vero Judaeos jam corde compun-ctos alloquens, sic exponit iis quid esset eorum officii, Poenitentiam agite, & baptize-tur unusquisque vestrum in nomine Jesu Christi in remissionem peccatorum, & accipietis donum Spiritus Sancti. Act. 2. 38. Ac priusquam aliquis justitia satietur, requiritur ut illam sitiat & esuriat, juxta Christi pronunciatum, Beati qui esuriunt & sitiunt justitiam, quoniam ipsi saturabuntur. Matth. 5. 6.
pass_a_gloss: For that sanctifying Spirit, filling and adorning the soul with grace, is not promised in the Gospel except to believers and penitents. He who believes in me, says Christ, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water. But this he said of the Spirit which those who believed in him were to receive (John 7:38). And Peter, addressing the Jews already pricked in heart, thus sets forth what their duty was: Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and you shall receive the gift of the Holy Spirit (Acts 2:38). And before anyone is filled with righteousness, it is required that he thirst and hunger for it, according to Christ's pronouncement: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be filled (Matthew 5:6).
pass_b_english: The sanctifying Spirit is promised only to believers and penitents—Jn 7; Acts 2:38.
One must hunger and thirst for righteousness before being filled—Matt 5:6.

choices.why: Key lemma for De Justitia densify §1052.
